title: ShieldCare Plan Terms: Length of Cover, What the Term Runs From, and the Waiting Period
content:
The term of a Northbeam ShieldCare Protection Plan, the day its cover is counted from, the
waiting period before it will pay, the age an item may still be brought under a plan, and
the number of covered items one plan record may carry are as entered in the following
conditions.

| Plan | Term sold, whole months | Waiting period after activation, days | The term is counted from | Item may still be covered within, days of its purchase | Covered items one plan record carries |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| ShieldCare Essential Parts and Labour | 24 | 30 | the day the covered item was delivered | 30 | 1 |
| ShieldCare Accidental Damage Plus | 24 | 30 | the day the covered item was delivered | 60 | 1 |
| ShieldCare Total Device Protection | 36 | 15 | the day the covered item was delivered | 60 | 3 |
| ShieldCare Home Theatre Premium | 48 | 15 | the day the covered item was installed | 90 | 4 |
| ShieldCare Major Appliance Extended Service | 60 | 30 | the day the covered item was delivered | 30 | 1 |
| ShieldCare Business Fleet Protection | 36 | 0 | the day the plan was activated | 120 | 50 |

Condition 1. The waiting period is the number of days after activation before the plan will
pay a claim. ShieldCare Business Fleet Protection carries a waiting period of 0 days, so a
claim on that plan is not held back for any waiting period at all.

Condition 2. The day the term is counted from is not the same across the plans. On
ShieldCare Home Theatre Premium the term is counted from the day the covered item was
installed; on ShieldCare Business Fleet Protection it is counted from the day the plan was
activated; on the other four it is counted from the day the covered item was delivered.

Condition 3. The age limit is a limit on the item, not on the plan: it states how many days
after the item's own purchase a plan may still be added to it. It runs from 30 days on
ShieldCare Essential Parts and Labour and ShieldCare Major Appliance Extended Service out to
120 days on ShieldCare Business Fleet Protection.

Condition 4. One plan record carries a single covered item on three of the plans, 3 items on
ShieldCare Total Device Protection, 4 on ShieldCare Home Theatre Premium and up to 50 on
ShieldCare Business Fleet Protection.
